title: A lifetime of 100TB cloud storage now costs less than $975, down from $9,900
content_html:
TL;DR Internxt’s 100TB encrypted cloud storage plan is on sale for $974.97 (reg. $9,900), down 90%, for new users only.

Credit: Internxt

$974.97
$9,900 Save $8,925.03

Most cloud storage plans charge every month for as long as you use them, and enterprise-level storage tiers can run thousands of dollars a year for large teams. A lifetime subscription to Internxt helps you cancel cloud subscriptions — 100 TB of storage is on sale for $974.97 (reg. $9,900).

Every file gets encrypted on your device before it ever reaches Internxt’s servers, so the company can’t see, read, or share what you store. Internxt also adds post-quantum encryption, protection against the kind of quantum computers researchers expect could eventually crack today’s standard AES-256 encryption. Internxt keeps its full codebase open-source on GitHub, conducts independent audits by the security firm Securitum, and is GDPR-compliant.

Storage syncs across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and the web, with no cap on the number of devices you connect. PCWorld named Internxt’s lifetime plans an Editors’ Choice pick for the value alone.

A one-time payment beats renting enterprise storage every month, especially for archives this large. This lifetime deal includes only 100 TB of Internxt Drive storage. Extras like Internxt’s Mail, Meet, and Backups tools are sold separately, and the offer is limited to new Internxt users.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get 100 TB of lifetime cloud storage for $974.97 (reg. $9,900), 90% off.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
